<div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5581"/><div sID="gen8471" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5581"/>4-6. Their conduct evinces indifference rather than ignorance of God; for when He appears in judgment, they are stricken with great fear.<div eID="gen8471" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen8472" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">who eat up my people--</hi>to express their beastly fury (<reference osisRef="Prov.30.14">Pr 30:14</reference>; <reference osisRef="Hab.3.14">Ha 3:14</reference>). To "call on the Lord" is to worship Him. <div eID="gen8472" type="x-p"/>
entries.content_plain: 4-6. Their conduct evinces indifference rather than ignorance of God; for when He appears in judgment, they are stricken with great fear. who eat up my people-- to express their beastly fury ( Pr 30:14 ; Ha 3:14 ). To "call on the Lord" is to worship Him.
entries.reader_content_plain: 4-6. Their conduct evinces indifference rather than ignorance of God; for when He appears in judgment, they are stricken with great fear. who eat up my people-- to express their beastly fury ( Pr 30:14 ; Ha 3:14 ). To "call on the Lord" is to worship Him.

entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5582"/><div sID="gen8473" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5582"/><hi type="bold">7. captivity--</hi>denotes any great evil.<div eID="gen8473" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen8474" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">Zion--</hi>God's abode, from which He revealed His purposes of mercy, as He now does by the Church (compare <reference osisRef="Ps.3.4">Psa 3:4</reference>; <reference osisRef="Ps.20.2">20:2</reference>), and which He rules and in which He does all other things for the good of His people (<reference osisRef="Eph.1.22">Ep 1:22</reference>). <chapter eID="Ps.14"/>
entries.content_plain: 7. captivity-- denotes any great evil. Zion-- God's abode, from which He revealed His purposes of mercy, as He now does by the Church (compare Psa 3:4 ; 20:2 ), and which He rules and in which He does all other things for the good of His people ( Ep 1:22 ).
